notes.title: Watch and control
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
This is interface and gamepad support update.
Changes:
[list]
[*] Gamepad support!
[*] Visual tutorial updated and supplemented
[*] HP line changed, icons of food and money changed
[*] Icons in phone market changed
[*] Difficulty choice is more obvious now
[*] Dialog colors and boxes changed
[*] Bullet hell car is more visible
[*] Dragons are slower
[*] Small visual bugs fixed
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989882/201b9aed839d43098cd7076f9e8853786523759e.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989882/0ab1ddfbb55d0e03dab1ec054dce30ea6e8d3014.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989882/38671afaa65d8c01104202501c48fa15c35188b3.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989882/fbe8d06bebfccb0c9c132fa7e426f439e6b090c0.png[/img]

There will be small cute interactions in car riding segment soon.
Stay tuned!
